chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Ahmad ibn Abdillah from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from a man from the general populace, who raised it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
One who recites in the Mushaf by looking at it, his eyes will be strengthened and the chastisement of his parents will be reduced, even if they were disbelievers.

key_terms.الْمُصْحَفِ: The compiled copy of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What are the rewards for reciting the Quran by looking at the Mushaf?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the tangible spiritual benefits of *qira'ah bi-l-nazar* (recitation by sight), linking the physical act of reading to the purification of the eyes and the alleviation of parental punishment. Notably, the reward extends to parents regardless of their faith status, reflecting the Shia principle of *al-husn min ghayr shart* (goodness without condition) in intercessory merits. This underscores the Quran’s role as a universal source of mercy that bridges the gap between the believer’s devotion and their ancestors’ spiritual state.
